question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH ent_first_second AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS second_style
    FROM (
        SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) AS rn
        FROM Entertainer_Styles
    )
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
),
cust_first_second AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS second_style
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerID, StyleID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq ASC) AS rn
        FROM Musical_Preferences
    )
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
ent_valid AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
cust_valid AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM ent_first_second efs
JOIN cust_first_second cfs ON TRUE
JOIN ent_valid ev ON efs.EntertainerID = ev.EntertainerID
JOIN cust_valid cv ON cfs.CustomerID = cv.CustomerID
JOIN Entertainers e ON efs.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cfs.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE (efs.first_style = cfs.first_style AND efs.second_style = cfs.second_style)
   OR (efs.first_style = cfs.second_style AND efs.second_style = cfs.first_style)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
